issue.title: fr.json is missing the scheduled export email strings
issue.body:
My profile language is French, and the weekly summary and password reset emails
arrive in French, but our scheduled exports always come in English: the subject
is "Scheduled export: Dépenses cartes" and the body starts "Your scheduled
export of". I think `src/i18n/fr.json` is simply missing the `email.export`
strings, so they fall back to English. Could someone add the French ones? Three
of our report owners have asked.

input.title: Send scheduled export emails in the recipient's locale
input.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

fr.json already contains email.export.subject and email.export.body, so the translations are not missing. In runScheduledExport, the call to scheduledExportEmail(report, schedule.recipients, rows.length) passes no locale, so the function's default "en" is used. Change the call to pass the locale of the recipient (for example the report owner's profile locale, looked up alongside the schedule), so the French strings are used when the owner's profile language is French.
